chunks: And most of them follow nothing but assumption; indeed, assumption does not avail against the truth at all. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between assumption (Zann) and truth in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the reliance on unverified conjecture (ظن) as a primary source of religious or legal truth, contrasting it with the certainty derived from the Ahl al-Bayt's infallible guidance. It underscores that while the masses may follow popular opinion, true knowledge requires rigorous verification, a principle central to Usul al-Fiqh. The verse concludes by affirming Allah's omniscience, serving as a divine warning against intellectual complacency.
